name: conclave-finance-studio
position: Gate 7 — Code (pass 17, approved UX redesign); gates 9-11 follow
notes: Sits ON TOP of Oracle ERP Cloud data in a warehouse. Detects and resolves close anomalies; triggers postings into ERP. Does NOT imitate GL. Surface is a natural-language, dataset-selection agent interface with guardrails.

loop_backs.reason: functional-agent devil's-advocate pass found six required changes before the backlog can go to approval — chiefly that criterion 9 (F4 ERP tie-back) is the only blocking acceptance criterion the build as scoped cannot pass, and that F8 does not defeat the self-justification mechanism it was written for

SCOPE CORRECTION (human): the system sits on top of Oracle ERP Cloud data in a warehouse and must not imitate the GL. F6/F7/F8/F11 were rebuilding Oracle ARCS. Backlog re-cut around anomaly detection/resolution plus a natural-language dataset-selection interface with guardrails.
Architects added requirements no criterion covers: supersession-by-data, routing budget, and security's seven new. Verification would report them NOT VERIFIED.

Gate 8 found green scenarios asserting what the register says is false: AC-F1-08 satisfied by a self-written date, and 8 red-team scenarios named '...never reaches a surface however phrased' while a working evasion (evasive prose + treatment + substantiated ground) reaches a surface untested.
94 in-scope criteria unevidenced, dominated by four detector families never built (F26 10, F28 10, F9 8, F33 11). Plus 3 contradictions where a green check claims more than the register permits.
loop_backs.resolution: Pass 5: F26, F28, F9 and F33 built with 41 AC IDs newly evidenced. AC-F26-05 left NOT VERIFIED (no close clock, register 6). AC-F41-08 and AC-REFUSAL-11 left NOT VERIFIED with the reason recorded and no scenario naming either. AC-F12-20's dossier leg built, closing register 11. FUNCTIONAL_SPEC 27.11 arithmetic corrected to 263 issued / 262 live at v1.1.1, no ID renumbered.

route_changes.change: Gate 7 re-opened after gate 8 closed, to implement the UX redesign the human approved. Gate 9 returns to pending: the IA move relocates elements that observable-UI criteria assert are visible on specific screens, so the prior audit no longer describes the tree.

served_url_note: Pilot build, not a deployment — gate 11 has not run. Started with `CONCLAVE_ENV=pilot API_PORT=8030 GES_PORT=8031 .venv/bin/python backend/pilot.py`. Default port is 8021; 8030 is used so test-agent's smoke runs on 8021 do not collide with the human's own instance. In this configuration the broker runs inside the api process (register 19), which is refused under CONCLAVE_ENV=production.
